Command.Name: Subtotal
Command.FPOperation: Calculate the subtotal amount with printing and display visualization options. Provide information about values of the calculated amounts. If a percent or value discount/addition has been specified the subtotal and the discount/addition value will be printed regardless the parameter for printing.

Arg.Name: DiscAddV
Arg.Desc: Up to 13 symbols for the value of the discount/addition. Use minus sign '-' for discount

Arg.Name: DiscAddP
Arg.Desc: Up to 7 symbols for the percentage value of the discount/addition. Use minus sign '-' for discount

Res.Name: SubtotalValue
Res.Desc: Up to 13 symbols for the value of the subtotal amount
